name: golden-flow-prod-main-default-checkpoint
purpose: Lock the restored Golden Flow as production main default on b6fedca-plus-search-surface-recovery.
rules: Golden Follow/Mute/Like/Return CT is the main default flow.
Non-Golden additions remain fallback-only unless explicitly documented and approved.
Do not modify locked files without explicit Liam GO.
Do not modify _run_follow_target_rotation without explicit Liam GO.
Do not silently fall back to default 2/3 CT rotation for prod/scheduled accounts.
Run required_tests_before_release after any locked-file change.
Update this checkpoint manifest if core file hashes change.

locked_files.role: Golden open/follow/mute/like/return CT nominal path and documented fallbacks.
locked_files.anti_regression_rule: Search Recovery must not run pre-entry on profile_verified=True when mode=fallback. Return CT stale action bar must not be nominal when mode=off.

locked_files.role: Modern account_session orchestration, rotation settings load, CT contract log guard.
CT contract audit, idempotent provisioning, controlled repair.
locked_files.anti_regression_rule: No silent DB mutation during account_session runs. Repair requires repair_go=True.
ensure creates missing rows only; upsert reserved for explicit repair_go.

locked_files.role: Provisioning ready hook for CT contract row creation.
locked_files.anti_regression_rule: Provisioning ready must attempt idempotent 30/4 row creation without touching other settings tables.
Defaults must remain: like strict=fallback, search recovery=fallback, return CT stale=off.

locked_files.role: Golden nominal path and mode helper regression tests.
locked_files.anti_regression_rule: Must pass before any navigation checkpoint change.
Must pass before any CT settings helper change.

locked_files.role: Like Phase 1 fallback and return CT regression coverage.
locked_files.anti_regression_rule: Nominal like path must not require strict grid proof.
Golden reopen must precede search recovery in return_to_followers_list.
